name: City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, August 26, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Waronek
d.
Roll Call
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Dr. Richard Vladovic, Los Angeles Unified School District Board President Board, District 7
b.
Jan Vogel, South Bay Workforce Investment Board Quarterly Update
c.
Check presentation to the Lomita Little League
d.
Employees of the Quarter (Full-Time and Part-Time)
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting of July 29, 2015 and the Regular Meeting held on August 12, 2015.
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2015-43 Approving the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Change Order No. 1 with Builder Boy Contractors in the amount of $8,250 for the Stephenson Center Exterior Replacement Project.
ACTION: Approve Changer Order No. 1 with Builder Boy Contractors in the amount of $8,250 for the Stephenson Center Exterior Replacement Project.
Item #7d
e.
Consideration of resolutions to allow property owners within the City of Lomita to participate in Ygrene Works for California PACE Financing Program
Res 2015-44 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita consenting to inclusion of properties within the City's jurisdiction in the California Home Finance Authority Community Facilities District No. 2014-1 (Clean Energy) and approving associate membership in the Joint Exercise of Powers Authority related thereto.
Res 2015-45 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita consenting to inclusion of properties within the City's jurisdiction in the California Home Finance Authority PACE Program and approving associate membership in the Joint Exercise of Powers Authority related thereto.
ACTION: To adopt the resolutions: 1) Consenting to inclusion of properties within the City's incorporated area in CHF Community Facilities District No. 2014-1 (Clean Energy) and approving associate membership in CHF; and 2) Consenting to inclusion of properties within the City's incorporated area in the CHF PACE Program and approving membership in CHF.
Item #7e
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFF'S QUARTERLY REPORT
Presented by Captain Bolin and Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department Staff
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
9.
OVERVIEW OF THE NEIGHBORHOOD WATCH PROGRAM
Presented by Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department Staff
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on September 9, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
